timer.recoveryBody: TimeBuddy closed while a block was running. Keep {{minutes}} min?
timer.recoveryNothing: Too little time had passed to be worth keeping.
timer.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

clients.title: Clients
clients.name: Name
clients.noProjects: No projects for this client yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.followSystemHint: Off by default. While this is on, Windows chooses between Walnut and Sand.
settings.chime: Chime at the end of a block
settings.notifications: Windows notification at the end of a block

backup.title: Backups
backup.hint: TimeBuddy copies the database here once a day and keeps the last seven. A folder that syncs — OneDrive, Dropbox — means a broken laptop is not a lost year.
backup.never: No backup has been made yet.
backup.staleNote: That is longer ago than it should be — check that the backup folder can be reached.
backup.failedWithLast: The last backup did not work. The newest copy is from {{when}}. Check that the backup folder can be reached.
backup.failedWithNone: The last backup did not work and there is no backup at all — your hours exist in one place only. Check that the backup folder can be reached.

restore.title: Restore
restore.hint: Going back to a backup replaces everything with how things were that day. TimeBuddy copies today's data aside first, as its own backup, so a restore can be undone. It takes effect the next time the app starts.
restore.noneToRestore: There are no backups to restore from yet.
restore.cost: Restoring from {{when}} discards {{entries}} entries logged since then — {{hours}} of work.
restore.costNothing: Restoring from {{when}} discards nothing: no hours have been logged since.
restore.pending: A restore from {{when}} is ready and will be applied the next time TimeBuddy starts.
restore.pendingHow: Quit from the tray icon to apply it — closing the window only hides it, and the restore needs the app to have fully stopped.
restore.previousSavedAs: The data from before it was kept as {{file}}.
restore.doneFrom: TimeBuddy was restored from the backup of {{when}}.
restore.passwordIsFromThen: Your password travelled with it, so the one that opens the app now is the one you were using on that day.
restore.dataUntouched: Nothing was overwritten — this is the data you already had.
restore.failedRejected: The restore did not happen: the backup could not be read when the app started. It may have been part-way through syncing.
restore.failedSafetyCopy: The restore did not happen: today's data could not be copied aside first, so nothing was replaced. Check that the backup folder can be reached — the restore is still ready for the next start.
restore.failedSwap: The restore did not happen: the files could not be moved.

error.durationUnreadable: Can't read that duration. Try 1:30, 1.5 or 90m.
error.durationNotPositive: Enter a duration greater than zero.
error.durationExceedsDay: An entry cannot be longer than 24 hours.
error.dateInFuture: That date is in the future.
error.rangeEndsBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
error.durationSettingNotPositive: Enter a duration greater than zero.
error.exportFailed: The file could not be saved.
error.backupFailed: The backup could not be written. Check the backup folder.
error.restoreFailed: The backup could not be prepared for restore. Nothing was changed.
error.backupUnreadable: That backup cannot be read — it may be damaged or still syncing. Nothing was changed.
error.backupFromNewerVersion: That backup was made by a newer version of TimeBuddy, so it cannot be restored here.
error.notABackup: That is not a TimeBuddy backup.
error.autostartFailed: Windows would not let TimeBuddy start automatically. Nothing was saved.
error.trayFailed: No tray icon could be created. Close now really closes.
error.unknown: That didn't work. Please try again.
error.recoveryPhraseTooShort: Use a recovery phrase of at least 12 characters.
error.accountAlreadyExists: This install already has an account.
error.wrongRecoveryPhrase: That recovery phrase is not right.

tray.hiddenNotice: TimeBuddy is still running in the system tray. Quit from the tray icon.

unlock.title: Unlock TimeBuddy
unlock.recoverHint: Enter the recovery phrase from setup. This happens entirely on this laptop — there is no email and no reset link.
unlock.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

wizard.passwordHint: TimeBuddy asks for this at launch, so it does not open straight into your hours.
wizard.recoveryHint: Write this down somewhere safe. It is the only way back in if you forget your password — your hours are never lost, but without it the password cannot be changed.
wizard.backupHint: TimeBuddy copies your hours here once a day. A folder that syncs — OneDrive, Dropbox — means a broken laptop is not a lost year.
wizard.workHint: One client and one project, so the Timer has something to start on. More can be added later.
